mera_relevance: Neutral atom platforms can implement MERA-like circuits via Rydberg blockade interactions. The all-to-all programmable connectivity of neutral atoms is favorable for tensor network circuits. Pasqal is a secondary hardware target — their systems have lower gate fidelity than Quantinuum Helios but are more widely deployed in Europe. The CINECA deployment creates a potential European academic access path. The networked QPU direction could eventually enable distributed MERA across multiple QPUs.
